in_hebrew.name: Chariot
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Divine warrior vehicle
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Chariot הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. In ancient Greek, the word chariot referred to a divine warrior vehicle, often pulled by two horses or sphinxes. In Christianity, it is associated with the chariots of Elijah and Elijah's successor Elisha, as well as the chariot of God's presence in the Old Testament.

in_greek.name: Chariot
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Divine warrior vehicle
in_greek.long_meaning: Chariot είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. In ancient Greek, the word chariot referred to a divine warrior vehicle, often pulled by two horses or sphinxes. In Christianity, it is associated with the chariots of Elijah and Elijah's successor Elisha, as well as the chariot of God's presence in the Old Testament.
